## Repository and pinned SHA
Public URL, branch/commit, observed date.

## Claims to verify
Separate README claims from functionality actually executed.

## Steps and environment
Exact commands, versions, test setup and whether keys or a GPU were used.

## Findings
Build tests, mock vs live integration, license/NOTICE, dependency/SBOM, performance, security and maintenance status.

## Decision
Adopt / adapt selective pieces / defer / reject with evidence.

## Next PR
Scope, interfaces, acceptance and rollback.

**Do not import code just to complete this audit.**
